                                            <article class="post-1159 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail hentry category-comida">
        <div class="entry-content"><p data-start="143" data-end="366">La gastronomía vietnamita es <strong data-start="172" data-end="190">rica y diversa</strong> según cada región, y cada lugar tiene su <strong data-start="232" data-end="262">encanto culinario especial</strong>. A continuación, te presento <strong data-start="292" data-end="365">los destinos más destacados para disfrutar la mejor comida en Vietnam</strong>:</p>
<hr data-start="368" data-end="371">
<h3 data-start="373" data-end="420">🌆 <strong data-start="380" data-end="420">1. Hanói – Sofisticación y tradición</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="421" data-end="660">
<li data-start="421" data-end="487">
<p data-start="423" data-end="487"><strong data-start="423" data-end="443">Características:</strong> Sabores suaves, equilibrio en ingredientes.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="488" data-end="584">
<p data-start="490" data-end="584"><strong data-start="490" data-end="512">Platos destacados:</strong> <em data-start="513" data-end="518">Phở</em>, <em data-start="520" data-end="529">bún chả</em>, <em data-start="531" data-end="542">bún thang</em>, <em data-start="544" data-end="560">chả cá Lã Vọng</em>, <em data-start="562" data-end="583">bánh cuốn Thanh Trì</em>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="585" data-end="660">
<p data-start="587" data-end="660"><strong data-start="587" data-end="608">Por qué probarlo:</strong> Cuna de la cocina tradicional del norte de Vietnam.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img decoding="async" class="aligncenter wp-image-1160 size-large" src="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-1024x639.jpg" alt="✅ En resumen:" width="1024" height="639" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-1024x639.jpg 1024w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-300x187.jpg 300w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-768x479.jpg 768w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-780x487.jpg 780w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-600x375.jpg 600w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-550x343.jpg 550w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-370x231.jpg 370w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-255x159.jpg 255w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam-150x94.jpg 150w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-hoi-an-vietnam.jpg 1200w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px"></p>
<hr data-start="662" data-end="665">
<h3 data-start="667" data-end="712">🏯 <strong data-start="674" data-end="712">2. Huế – Refinada, estilo imperial</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="713" data-end="969">
<li data-start="713" data-end="800">
<p data-start="715" data-end="800"><strong data-start="715" data-end="735">Características:</strong> Platos pequeños, presentaciones delicadas, elaboración compleja.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="801" data-end="896">
<p data-start="803" data-end="896"><strong data-start="803" data-end="825">Platos destacados:</strong> <em data-start="826" data-end="838">Bún bò Huế</em>, <em data-start="840" data-end="849">cơm hến</em>, <em data-start="851" data-end="873">bánh bèo – nậm – lọc</em>, <em data-start="875" data-end="884">chè Huế</em>, <em data-start="886" data-end="895">nem lụi</em>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="897" data-end="969">
<p data-start="899" data-end="969"><strong data-start="899" data-end="920">Por qué probarlo:</strong> Influencia directa de la cocina real vietnamita.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img decoding="async" class="aligncenter wp-image-1161 size-full" src="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue.jpg" alt="Variedad de platos tradicionales de Hue, Vietnam" width="800" height="533" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue.jpg 800w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-300x200.jpg 300w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-768x512.jpg 768w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-780x520.jpg 780w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-600x400.jpg 600w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-550x366.jpg 550w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-370x247.jpg 370w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-255x170.jpg 255w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/do-an-ngon-o-hue-150x100.jpg 150w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></p>
<hr data-start="971" data-end="974">
<h3 data-start="976" data-end="1019">🌊 <strong data-start="983" data-end="1019">3. Đà Nẵng – Sabrosa y auténtica</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="1020" data-end="1262">
<li data-start="1020" data-end="1092">
<p data-start="1022" data-end="1092"><strong data-start="1022" data-end="1042">Características:</strong> Sabores intensos, picantes, ingredientes frescos.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1093" data-end="1182">
<p data-start="1095" data-end="1182"><strong data-start="1095" data-end="1117">Platos destacados:</strong> <em data-start="1118" data-end="1128">Mì Quảng</em>, <em data-start="1130" data-end="1143">bún mắm nêm</em>, <em data-start="1145" data-end="1171">bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo</em>, mariscos.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1183" data-end="1262">
<p data-start="1185" data-end="1262"><strong data-start="1185" data-end="1206">Por qué probarlo:</strong> Muy variado, accesible, ideal para los amantes del mar.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="aligncenter wp-image-1162 size-full" src="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam.jpg" alt="✅ En resumen:" width="800" height="550" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam.jpg 800w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-300x206.jpg 300w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-768x528.jpg 768w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-780x536.jpg 780w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-600x413.jpg 600w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-550x378.jpg 550w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-370x254.jpg 370w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-255x175.jpg 255w, /wp-content/uploads/2025/06/comida-en-da-nang-viet-nam-150x103.jpg 150w" sizes="(max-width: 800px) 100vw, 800px"></p>
<hr data-start="1264" data-end="1267">
<h3 data-start="1269" data-end="1322">🛶 <strong data-start="1276" data-end="1322">4. Hội An – Fusión cultural y gastronómica</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="1323" data-end="1545">
<li data-start="1323" data-end="1385">
<p data-start="1325" data-end="1385"><strong data-start="1325" data-end="1345">Características:</strong> Mezcla entre cocina local y occidental.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1386" data-end="1471">
<p data-start="1388" data-end="1471"><strong data-start="1388" data-end="1410">Platos destacados:</strong> <em data-start="1411" data-end="1420">Cao lầu</em>, <em data-start="1422" data-end="1432">mì Quảng</em>, <em data-start="1434" data-end="1453">bánh bao bánh vạc</em>, <em data-start="1455" data-end="1470">cơm gà Hội An</em>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1472" data-end="1545">
<p data-start="1474" data-end="1545"><strong data-start="1474" data-end="1495">Por qué probarlo:</strong> Sabores únicos en un entorno colonial encantador.</p>
